atlas_seed.annotation_policy: No contact, chunk, rigidity, or grammar annotations were computed or retained for the seed, and none may be read back from this record.
atlas_seed.reason: The known-best atlas retains one normalized Witness/v2 construction and one house rendering for every n in this range under the same retention policy the seed was built to respect, so the seed indexed nothing the known-best collection does not now carry. Its 101 witnesses and 101 house renderings were removed rather than left to drift beside their known-best counterparts.
